title: Brand New Chic Apt in the Heart of Nashville!
description:
Welcome to your home in the heart of Downtown Nashville!

Located just minutes from Broadway, you're within walking distance of Nashville’s best live music venues, restaurants, bars, and attractions. Despite being in the middle of the action, the unit provides a private escape when you're ready to relax.

This units sleeps 4 and includes amenities such as, WiFi, smart tv, in-unit washer & dryer, keyless entry for easy check-in, professionally cleaned, and more!

Parking $30/night

The space
This unit comfortably accommodates up to 4 guests, featuring a queen-size bed in the bedroom and a king-size pull-out sleeper sofa in the living room.

Enjoy your favorite streaming apps on the 50-inch Smart TVs.

The kitchen is equipped with all basic essentials for your stay, along with a small dining table that can also be used as a dedicated workspace.

Located in the heart of Nashville, you’ll be within walking distance to some of the city’s most popular attractions:

📍 Nearby:
• 15 min walk to Broadway (bars & nightlife)
• 15 min walk to Assembly Food Hall
• 10 min walk to Bridgestone Arena
• 10 min walk to Country Music Hall of Fame
• 8 min walk to Music City Center

Permit #T2022056422

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire unit, along with the building’s available amenities, including the pool and 24-hour gym. Enjoy a comfortable, private stay with everything you need!
